email.subject: Quick fix for Northwind Pros Plumbing's site
email.body:
Hi Ben,

I checked your site and found two things likely costing you jobs: there's no click-to-call link, so mobile visitors searching for a plumber can't tap to dial you, and there's no booking option, so anyone ready to schedule has to call during business hours or give up. I also noticed no posted hours and an outdated footer, which can make visitors unsure you're still active.

I fix these for a flat fee, no ongoing contracts. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough this week where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
